items.tldr: OpenAI's actual revenue run-rate came in ~$18-20B below expectations; Nvidia briefly lost ~$200B in value, Oracle and CoreWeave fell too.
items.tldr_zh: OpenAI 实际营收run-rate比此前预期低约$180-200亿，英伟达一度蒸发约2000亿美元市值，Oracle、CoreWeave同跌
items.take: When one company's revenue forecast is collateral for an entire supply chain, who is the real house?
items.take_zh: 当一家公司的"收入预期"是整个产业链的抵押品，谁才是真正的庄家？

items.tldr: Study: the more people trust AI, the more prone they are to 'cognitive surrender' — adopting answers without checking.
items.tldr_zh: 研究发现：越信任AI的人越容易"认知投降"——不再核对，直接采纳
items.take: Is your judgment outsourced, or your skepticism atrophied? Which is harder to rescue?
items.take_zh: 工具变强，是你的判断力外包了，还是你的怀疑力萎缩了？这两者哪个更难救？

items.tldr: Study: highly intelligent people are more likely to ditch old habits for better ideas.
items.tldr_zh: 研究发现：高智商者更愿意抛弃旧习惯，接受更好的想法
items.take: Smart people change their minds fast; AI users stop changing theirs. Who is using whose brain?
items.take_zh: 聪明人"改主意"快，和AI用户"不改主意"（直接采纳）——谁在用谁的大脑？
